events.event: CNBC Indonesia, citing the Straits Times and a government source, reported that Polri searched the Jakarta office of Singapore-based Megaspeed at the FBI's request in search of Nvidia chips, finding server racks with no GPUs.
events.key_numbers: Megaspeed Nvidia purchases over US$4.8 billion since June 2024 (largest SE Asia buyer) · MettaDC Cikarang 36 MW · raid reportedly early 2026, before the scandal went public · no police statement
events.why_it_matters: Indonesia may be a transit route for banned Nvidia AI chips headed to China, which could draw US export pressure on local data centres.
events.spreading_evidence: Three CNBC Indonesia tech items on 17 Nov (raid, Indosat response, Singapore smuggling)

events.event: Indosat denied any commercial relationship with Megaspeed, while a NexAI Digital Infrastruktur disclosure names both Megaspeed International Indonesia and Indosat as tenants of the MettaDC Cikarang and planned Batang data centres.
events.key_numbers: Indosat: no commercial relationship · MettaDC 36 MW Cikarang · planned Batang 60 MW · Megaspeed purchases US$4.8 billion since Jun 2024 · no GPU count for Indonesia given
events.why_it_matters: A listed telco's denial conflicts with a data-centre filing, which matters for investors in ISAT and MGLV.

events.event: CNBC Indonesia, citing the State of Scams Indonesia 2026 report, said Indonesians lost Rp104.3 trillion to digital scams over the past year, with nearly half of victims scammed more than once.
events.key_numbers: Total loss Rp104.3T · average loss Rp4.89 million per victim · median Rp1.24 million · 70% of adults faced a scam attempt (66% in 2025) · 63 attempts per person per year · 47% of victims scammed repeatedly · survey of 1,160 adults, 16 Mar-13 Apr 2026 · OJK digital fraud reports above 700,000 (CNBC, 16 Nov, headline only)
events.why_it_matters: A huge, relatable loss figure that touches almost every phone user; but it is a 1,160-person survey, so the total is an extrapolation.

events.event: Bareskrim Polri announced it had blocked 322 bank accounts and seized Rp28.01 billion in a probe of an online gambling site identified only as 'A', whose servers are in Finland and the US.
events.key_numbers: 322 blocked accounts · Rp28.01 billion seized (may rise) · servers in Finland and US · site still operating, reachable via VPN despite Komdigi block · no suspect named
events.why_it_matters: Shows that blocking sites does not stop judol, and that ordinary bank accounts are used to move the money.

events.event: CNBC Indonesia reported that Uber notified drivers that 149,346 people had their names, addresses, birth dates and driver's licence numbers stolen through a breach at third-party AI provider Fireworks AI.
events.key_numbers: 149,346 drivers · data: name, address, date of birth, driver's licence number · notices began early Nov 2026 · Uber's second breach in 2026 (after Uber Freight) · drivers' countries not stated
events.why_it_matters: Even a big platform's data can leak through a vendor; unclear whether Indonesian drivers are affected.

events.event: CNBC Indonesia reported Microsoft's explanation of the 13 November global Microsoft 365 outage: a gateway-server bug from a July change, undetected for about three months, cascaded failures across servers.
events.key_numbers: Bug undetected ~3 months · ~14% of gateway capacity already offline · servers overwhelmed up to 80% · Teams switched gateways ~15 hours before outage · Microsoft apologised
events.why_it_matters: Explains why one cloud change can freeze email and Teams for offices worldwide, including Indonesian firms.

events.event: Minister of Higher Education, Science and Technology Brian Yuliarto and Peruri launched Chip Merah Putih, a domestic chip prototype designed with ITB, starting with e-passport use.
events.key_numbers: Chip Hackathon 2026: 89 teams, 338 students, 41 universities · no process node, fab or production target stated
events.why_it_matters: Indonesia's first branded home-grown chip, but it is a design prototype with no known manufacturing plan.

events.event: Nvidia was scheduled to report fiscal Q3 FY2027 results after US market close on 17 November, its first under interim CEO Colette Kress; results not verified in this sweep.
events.key_numbers: Report date 17 Nov (US) · shares reportedly down about 13% beforehand (Ajaib, snippet only)
events.why_it_matters: Sets the tone for AI-bubble fears and data-centre stocks, including Indonesian ones; results should be checked by the markets sweep.
